extraction.Name: Susan Bordeaux
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: it was worth more than that but I had to sell it on account of the taxes; I wanted to keep the place for a home but I had to sell it on account of the taxes
extraction.Occupation/Income: Samuel, my husband usually makes the living but he is laid up with a broken leg at present.
extraction.NOTES: Sold land for $5200.00 received in cash; patent delivered to mailbox at the Boarding School; did not sign receipt for patent; seven people depend on her for support; husband Samuel has a broken leg at present; notary is Jas. W. Cross, commission expires 4-28-32; document sworn May 7, 1929
